newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Metal forms Vietnam steel venture.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Metal forms Vietnam steel venture.

text.p: Sumitomo Metal Industries Ltd said on Friday it has formed a joint venture in Vietnam to produce steel pipes for use in motorcycle components such as handlebars and mufflers.

The new Hanoi-based company, named Vietnam Steel Products Ltd, is capitalised at $700,000 and is owned 60 percent by Sumitomo Metal, 30 percent by Nomura Boeki Co, an Osaka-based trading house of steel products and 10 percent by Mitsui & Co Ltd, a Sumitomo Metal spokesman said.
The company will invest $2.30 million to build a plant to start production in December with a monthly output rate of 100 tonnes, the spokesman said.

The products will be sold to Vietnamese units of Japanese motorcycle makers such as Suzuki Motor and Honda Motor. The company also plans to produce steel products for use in vehicles sometime in the future, he said.
